results.name: Seated Normal Grip Row Machine
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a row machine with a straight back and your feet placed on the footrests.
Hold the rod above your knees with an overhand grip of your hands while keeping your arms straight.
Pull the cable towards your chest by bending your arms and taking your elbows past your back.
Return to the initial position and repeat.
results.description: Seated Normal Grip Row Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Rear Shoulders.

results.name: Seated Resistance Band - Cable Rows
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs fully extended and feet together, anchoring the resistance band around the soles of your feet. Hold the handles with both hands, arms extended forward, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight, chest up, and core engaged to stabilize your body.
Pull the handles towards your torso by bending your elbows, keeping your arms close to your body. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position, maintaining control over the resistance band. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid slouching to maintain proper form.
Engage your core to prevent any rocking or unnecessary movement during the exercise.
Use a controlled motion to pull and release the resistance band, avoiding jerking movements.
results.description: Seated Resistance Band - Cable Rows is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps, Core.

results.name: Seated Row Machine Rows
instructions: Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad, or your feet on the platform, and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your shoulders down and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return the handles with control until your arms are straight and repeat.
tips: Don't rock your torso to move the weight.
Pause briefly with your shoulder blades squeezed.
results.description: Seated Row Machine Rows is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the upper back (back). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Rear Shoulders.

results.name: Single Arm Cable Row Left
instructions: Set the cable pulley to a mid position and attach a single handle. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grasp the handle with your left hand, arm extended towards the machine.
Slightly bend your knees, push your hips backward, and lean forward slightly for balance.
Pull the handle towards your torso, bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade back. Keeping your elbow close to your body.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch to the right arm.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handle towards your torso and inhale as you extend your arm back.
Use a weight that provides enough resistance to challenge your muscles without compromising form.
Avoid using your body to generate momentum; keep the movement isolated to your arm and back.
results.description: Single Arm Cable Row Left is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Straight Arm Cable Lat Pull Down
instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley holding a straight bar or rope, arms extended and slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward at the hips and brace your core.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Let the bar rise back to shoulder height with control and repeat.
tips: Your elbows stay fixed; the movement comes from your shoulders.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
results.description: Straight Arm Cable Lat Pull Down is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Rear Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Straight Bar Cable Pull Down
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, palms facing down.

Slightly bend your knees, push your hips back, and lean your torso forward slightly. Pull the bar down towards your thighs in a straight line, keeping your arms straight and your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the bar down until it reaches your thighs, feeling a strong contraction in your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position with control, maintaining tension in your lats. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Adjust the weight on the cable machine to provide enough challenge without compromising form.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them towards your ears.
results.description: Straight Bar Cable Pull Down is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Middle Back, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Straight Bar Cable Row Close Grip
instructions: Sit at a cable row machine with your feet placed on the footrests and knees slightly bent. Grasp the straight bar with a close grip, palms facing down.
Engage your core and maintain a straight back. Pull the bar towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your elbows close to your body.
Hold the contraction for a moment, feeling the muscles in your back activating.
Slowly extend your arms to return the bar to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you pull the bar towards you and inhale as you extend your arms.
Adjust the weight on the cable machine to provide enough challenge without compromising form.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them towards your ears.
results.description: Straight Bar Cable Row Close Grip is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms, Shoulders.
